answer: Sybil attackers must acquire and lock fresh stake for each fake identity while also burning compute to forge the chain forward. Each agent stakes a bonded relic tied to its verified history, and every new epoch requires solving a rotating proof-of-work challenge seeded by the prior epoch's ember hash. As the horizon of accumulated epochs grows, the cost of maintaining convincing parallel histories compounds, making mass identity creation economically irrational compared to honest single-identity participation. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
